author: william-booth
fields.title: Obulongoofu bw’Omutima
fields.description: Omutima gwa mazima guyinza okulongoosebwa—ne guteekebwa awatali kibi, ne gujjula okwagala, era ne gwewaayo ddala eri Katonda? Mu Obulongoofu bw’Omutima, William Booth annyonnyola ekkubo eridda mu kulongoosebwa munda, obulamu obutukuvu, n’obuwanguzi mu by’omwoyo. Mu bunnyonnyofu ne mu bwangu, akoowoola abakkiriza okwewaayo okusingawo n’okukyusibwa okw’olubeerera. Yingira mu bubaka buno obukyusa obulamu—era onoonye obulongoofu emmeeme yo bwe yatonderwa.

fields.title: Obulongoofu: Kye Buli
fields.body_html:
Matayo 5:8 agamba nti, “Balina omukisa abalina omutima omulongoofu, kubanga abo baliraba Katonda.”

Baganda bange abaagalwa, ffe Abaserikale b’Obulokozi buli kaseera tuyimba oba tusaba oba twogera ku Mutima Omulongoofu. Mazima ddala, waliwo ebintu bitono bye twogerako emirundi mingi okusinga kino, oba bye tuwaana mu butuufu okusinga. Ennyimba zaffe ezimu ezisinga obulungi era ezikwata ku mutima ziri ku mulamwa guno. Oboolyawo, tewali nnyimba gye tuyimba emirundi mingi okusinga eyo etandika nti, “Ayi, singa nnina omutima ogutendereza Katonda wange!

Omutima ogusumuluddwa okuva mu kibi!

Omutima oguwulira bulijjo Omusaayi, ogwayiibwa lwange n’obuntu bulamu! ” Ekyo tekirungi? Naye kyeyongera okuba ekirungi n’okusingawo -- “Omutima oguzzibwa obuggya mu buli kirowoozo, era ogujjudde Okwagala okw’Obwakatonda; Ogutuukiridde era ogutuufu, era ogulongoofu era omulungi, ekifaananyi Kyo, Mukama!”

Wadde ng’amaanyi g’ennyimba ng’ezo mu kukwasa emitima gyaffe manene, oboolyawo tewali kisanyusa Omuserikale ow’Obulokozi ow’amazima okusinga obujulizi obw’olwatu obw’abo abali mu kweyagalira Omukisa guno, oba okusaba okw’omuggundu okugusaba, oba okukoowoola okw’obunyiikivu eri Baganda okufuna Luulu eno ey’Omuwendo Omungi, kwe tuwulira emirundi mingi mu bibinja byaffe.

Kyokka Abaserikale baffe bangi tebafuna mu bukakafu era tebalangirira mu lwatu okweyagalira Omukisa guno; era mbadde ndowooza nti, oboolyawo, kiva ku nsonga nti omulamwa guno tegutegeerekeka bulungi nga bwe gwandibadde gutegeerekeka. N’olwekyo, njagala okugezaako okugunnyonnyola mu Bbaluwa entono, ze nsuubira nti Baganda bange banaazzaako omwoyo n’obwegendereza.

Kaakano, mwe musaba mujjukire nti omulamwa gwange ye “Obulongoofu bw’Omutima.” Njagala okunnyonnyola kye tutegeeza nga twogera ku Mutima Omulongoofu; okulaga engeri gye muyinza okufunamu eky’obugagga eky’omuwendo, bwe muba nga temunnakifuna; n’engeri gye muyinza okukuuma Omukisa nga mumaze okugufuna. Nnaatandika nga ngamba nti: Ffenna tumanyi amakulu g’okuba Omulongoofu. Bwe twogera ku bulongoofu bw’ebintu ebitwetoolodde, tutegeeza nti biba birongoofu era nga tebitabuddwamu kintu kirala. Tebiba byereere buwewere ku bucaafu oba obukyafu, wabula era tewaba kintu kya wansi ekitabuddwamu.

Bwe twogera nti omuntu mulongoofu, mu ndowooza ey’eddiini, tutegeeza nti mutuufu era mwesigwa era wa mazima munda ne kungulu; nti tayogera bwogezi kyokka, wabula akola ebintu ebikwata ku buvunaanyizibwa bwe eri Katonda n’eri omuntu.

Ekibi mu Baibuli kyogerwako ng’obucaafu oba obugwagwa bw’omubiri, obw’ebirowoozo, oba obw’omwoyo. N’olwekyo, obulongoofu mu ddiini kiteekwa okutegeeza obutaba na bintu bya bucaafu ng’obutamiivu, omululu, obukuusa, obulimba, amalala, ettima, obusungu, okwefaako wekka, obutakkiriza, obujeemu, n’ebirala ebifaanana.

Mu bufunze, okuba omulongoofu mu mwoyo kitegeeza okununulwa okuva mu buli kimu na buli ekintu Mukama ky’akulaga nti kiwakanya Okwagala Kwe Okutukuvu. Kitegeeza nti tolina busobozi bwokka obw’okubeera n’obulamu obw’engeri gy’ayagala, wabula ddala nti obubeeramu.

Kaakano, Obulongoofu, sirina kya kubagamba, Baganda bange, businzibwa nnyo era bwegombebwa nnyo abantu bonna abalina ebirowoozo ebituufu. Okusookera ddala: Ffenna twagala obulongoofu obw’omubiri; okugeza, nkakasa nti buli omu asoma ebbaluwa eno ayagala okuba n’omubiri omuyonjo. Bw’ogolokoka mu makya, toba mu ddembe okutuusa lw’oba weeyoze. Abasima eby’obugagga bwe bava mu bunnya, oba abalimi bwe bava mu nnimiro, oba abawala bwe bava mu ffekitale, ekintu kye basooka okusaba ye mazzi ge banaayozesa.

Oyagala engoye enjonjo n’engoye eza linena ennongoofu, si bwe kiri? Lowooza ku ssente n’omulimu ebiweebwayo mu kukuuma engoye zo nga nnongoofu. Oyagala amaka amayonjo. Laba omukyala ow’awaka bw’akuuna, n’anaaza, n’aweera, n’akungula enfuufu okukuuma ebbiga n’amadirisa, n’ebintu by’omu nnyumba nga birongoofu.

Oyagala ekibuga ekiyonjo. Nga waliwo okukyayira enguudo okw’okutegana n’okw’ensaasaanya, n’okutwala kasasiro; ne ssente eziweebwayo mu kuddaabiriza n’okuyonja ebisaawe by’amazzi amabi okukuuma ebibuga byaffe nga birungi era birongoofu. Twagala obulongoofu obw’engeri eno kubanga businga eriiso okusanyusa era bulungi eri obulamu. Tumanyi nti obucaafu bukyayibwa ennyongera, buzaala ebiwuka, buleeta kolera, kawumpuli, n’endwadde mu bujjuvu, era buyanguya abantu okutuuka mu ntaana. Bwe kityo, tubukyawa ne twogera nti, “Buggyeewo; ka tubeere abayonjo!”

Naye abantu bonna abalina ebirowoozo ebituufu basiima obulongoofu bw’omwoyo okusinga nnyo obulongoofu bw’omubiri, oba engoye, oba amaka, oba ekintu kirala kyonna; era ekyo, kubanga bwa mugaso nnyo okusingawo.

Okugeza: (a) Katonda ayagala Obulongoofu bw’Omwoyo. Bwe butonde Bwe okukola bwe kityo. Sirina kubuusabuusa nti, nga ffe, ayagala okulaba abaana Be nga bayonjo kungulu. Atugamba, ng’ayita mu Mutume Pawulo, nti tuteekwa okunaazibwa emibiri gyaffe n’amazzi amalongoofu, naye okunaaza omutima kwe kusinga okwegombebwa Gy’ali okukira okunaaza omubiri.

“Abatukuvu Be balungi mu maaso Ge, Atunuulira abaana Be n’essanyu; Alaba essuubi lyabwe, Amanyi okutya kwabwe, Era atunula, n’ayagala ekifaananyi Kye omwo.”

Yee, Katonda asanyukira Obutukuvu. Eggulu, ekifo Kye mw’abeera, kirongoofu. Abakibeeramu balongoofu. Emirimu gyamu, n’okwesanyusaamu, n’okusinza byonna bya bulongoofu bwe bumu.

(b) Bamalayika baagala Obulongoofu. Singa ekitonde kyonna ekitali kitukuvu, mu ngeri yonna, kandiyingizibwa mu Kibuga eky’Eggulu, abakibeeramu, nkakasa, bandyewala ekitonde ng’ekyo, nga ffe bwe twandyewadde omuntu alina endwadde ey’entiisa.

(c) Baddayimooni bamanyi nti Obulongoofu kintu kya muwendo, wadde nga babukyawa era babuwakanya n’amaanyi gaabwe gonna.

(d) Abantu bangi ababi basiima Obulongoofu. Babutunuulira ng’obulungi era ng’obwegombebwa mu balala, wadde nga babutwala ng’obutasoboka gye bali. Mu biseera byabwe eby’okulowooza, Omwoyo gwa Katonda bw’agulumba, ebijjukizo eby’ennaku entukuvu eziyise bwe bijjuza ebirowoozo byabwe, era bwe balaba abantu be bamanyi nti balongoofu era balungi, beekyawa olw’obucaafu bwabwe bo, wadde nga ebiseera byonna bagaana okuwuliriza Katonda, n’okukkiriza Obulokozi obwandibafudde abalongoofu.

(e) Emyoyo egyabula egiri mu Ggeyeena giwulira engeri Obutukuvu gye businga nnyo Obubi awatali kkomo. Kaakano balaba nga bwe kyandibadde kirungi nnyo gye bali singa baanaaza emitima gyabwe mu Musaayi gw’Omwana gw’Endiga bwe baali n’omukisa okukola bwe batyo. Ayi, kiki kye bandigaanyi okuwaayo okufuna emikisa ng’egyo gye mweyagalira mmwe!

Mwagala Obulongoofu, mikwano gyange? Oboolyawo mubulina. Oboolyawo mwagenda eri Yesu okufuna Amaanyi agalongoosa, ne mweegalamiza ku bigere Bye, ne muleka ebintu byammwe ebibuusibwabuusibwa, ne mweewaayo okukola Okwagala Kwe, oba nga muli balamu oba nga mufa, era ne mukkiriza nti Omusaayi gwa Yesu Kristo gubafudde abalongoofu.

Ayi, obanga okumanya okwo kubadde kwammwe, muli ba mukisa, era muli ba mukisa okusingawo bwe muba nga mutambulira mu maanyi n’emirembe egy’okumanya okwo leero. Bwe kiba bwe kityo, mbayozaayoza; nsanyukira mmwe, era ntendereza Katonda ku lwammwe.

Naye obanga Omukisa guno si gwammwe, mugwegomba? Okugulowoozaako kujjuza omwoyo gwammwe okwegomba? Kubafuula nga bwe kyali eri omuyimbi, bwe yayimba nti: “Ayi essuubi ery’ekitiibwa ery’okwagala okutuukiridde!

Linnyimusa eri ebintu eby’engulu, Linsitula ku biwaawaatiro by’empungu; Liwa omwoyo gwange oguwuubaadde okuloza, Era linfuula okumala akaseera ne ndya ku mbaga Wamu ne bakabona ba Yesu ne bakabaka.”

Mikwano gyange, essanyu lyammwe n’obuyinza bwammwe okukwatagana byonna n’okufuulibwa kwammwe abatukuvu. Ayi, mbeegayirira kaakano mufukamire wano musabe Katonda abafuule buli omu ku mmwe omulongoofu, ku Bw’amaanyi ag’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ng’ayita mu Musaayi gw’Omwana gw’Endiga.

fields.title: Obulongoofu nga Bwe Bulagirwa
fields.body_html:
Abaebbulaniya 12:14 wagamba nti, “Mufubenga okuba n’emirembe n’abantu bonna, era mufubenga okuba abatukuvu, kubanga atali mutukuvu taliraba Mukama.”

Mikwano gyange abaagalwa, Nate, njagala nzireeteeko ensonga gye nawandiikako mu bbaluwa yange eyaakayita. Mazima ddala, y’ensonga ey’omuwendo. Ngigadde era ngyogeddeko okuyita mu bulamu bwange bwonna obw’eddiini; ne leero, ntwala okusanyukira n’okubuulira Omukisa gw’Omutima Omulongoofu nga kikulu nnyo eri emirembe gyange, amaanyi gange, n’okugasa kwange, era nga kyetaagisa eri okukulaakulana n’okweyongera kw’Eggye nga bwe kyali bulijjo.

Okutegeera obulungi ensonga eno kijja kubayamba okufuna Omukisa guno mwekka, era kibasobozese okugunnyonnyola abalala.

Mu bbaluwa yange eyaakayita, nayogera ku Bulongoofu mu ngeri ey’awamu; mu eno, njagala njogere ku nsonga eno mu ngeri gy’ekwatako mu bulamu bwammwe. Mukama waffe omwagalwa yategeeza ki bwe yayogera ku “abalina omutima omulongoofu,” n’abayita ab’omukisa? Kitegeeza ki okuba n’Omutima Omulongoofu? Okuddamu ekibuuzo ekyo, nteekwa okusooka okubuuza ekirala: Omutima kitegeeza ki? Ekibuuzo ekyo nkiddamu nti, tetutegeeza kitundu ekyo ky’owulira nga kikuba mu kifuba kyo, era nga kye kikulu ekigatta omubiri gwonna. Ekyo kitundu kikulu nnyo mu muntu, era okukikuuma nga kiri bulungi kikulu nnyo.

Naye si mutima ogw’omu mubiri gwo Yesu Kristo gwe yali ayogerako mu kifo kino, era gwe njagala okwogerako naawe, wabula amaanyi ago, olw’okubanga ge gakulu mu mwoyo gwo, gasobola okugambibwa nti ge gakwatagana nagwo. Ng’omutima ogukuba mu kifuba kyo bwe gwe maanyi amakulu ag’omuntu ow’omubiri, bwe kityo n’omutima gwe twogerako gwe maanyi amakulu ag’Omuntu ow’Omwoyo.

(a) Mu ngeri eno, gwe Mutima gwo oguwulira essanyu oba ennaku. Bw’ogamba nti, “Omukazi oyo omunaku yafa olw’omutima omumenyese olw’obukambwe bwa bba,” otegeeza nti obuyinike obukaawa obw’emmeeme ye bwe bwamutta.

fields.title: Obulongoofu Butegeeza Okulokolebwa
fields.body_html:
Lukka 1:74-75 agamba nti, “okukituukiriza, n’okulokolebwa okuva mu mukono gw’abalabe baffe awatali kutya, tulyoke tuweereze mu maaso ge, mu butukuvu ne mu butuukirivu ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwaffe.”

Bannange abaagalwa, nsuubira nti sibakooya nga nziramu okudda ku nsonga ey’omutima omulongoofu. Ensonga eno nkulu nnyo, si eri Ekkanisa ya Kristo n’Eggye ery’Obulokozi bokka, naye eri ensi yonna, era kyeva kiteekwa okuddamu okwanjulwa.

fields.title: Obulongoofu nga Bwe Bunnyonnyolwa
fields.body_html:
Ebaluwa ey’Abaebbulaniya 13:20-21 egamba nti, “Kale, Katonda ow’emirembe eyazuukiza Mukama waffe Yesu, Omusumba w’endiga omukulu ow’endagaano etaggwaawo gye yanyweza n’omusaayi gwe, abawe buli kirungi kyonna kye mwetaaga okubasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, era atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo. Aweebwenga ekitiibwa emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina.”

Bannange abaagalwa, Waliwo kye njogedde ekireeseeko omuntu yenna mu mmwe okwegomba okufuna omukisa ogw’omuwendo omungi ennyo, ogutabalika — Omutima Omulongoofu? Waliwo mu Kikundi kyammwe eyawulirwa ng’ayimba nti, “Obulamu bwange bulifuna ddi okuwummula, Okulwana kwange n’okumeguzaganya bikome; Omutima gwange, nga gutwaliddwa Omulokozi wange, Guleme okutya so teguddeyo kwonoona?”

Be’abo “abalumwa enjala n’ennyonta olw’obutuukirivu” abalikkusibwa. Singa okwegomba okwo kutandise mu ggwe, ne bwe kuba mu ngeri entono, nsanyuka. Ka nkuyambe okwongera okunnyisa okwegomba okwo nga nkulaga ebimu ku mikisa egiva mu kuba n’omutima omulongoofu.

Era eky’olubereberye kye kino: 1. Omutima Omulongoofu Guleeta Obulamu Obutukuvu Naye obulamu obutukuvu ntegeeza ki? Bwe bulamu obulaga okuyigiriza n’ebisuubizo by’Ebyawandiikibwa—obulamu obukolebwa okugoberera ekyokulabirako kya Yesu Kristo. Tebujja kuba butuukiridde. Wanaabeerawo obunafu n’ensobi. Naye ng’omusana omuntu gw’afunye bwe guli, bujja kuba butukuvu ddala. Obulamu obwenkanidde awo tebusaanira kwegombebwa, bannange? Si nkizo nnene okulaga okukkiriza kwo mu maaso g’ab’omu maka go, bakozi bannammwe, n’ensi? Omuntu ng’oyo afuuka mukisa buli gy’alaga.

Tunuulira obulamu bwabwe: Beesigwa era ba mazima mu buli kye bakola—ku mulimu, awaka, ne buli wantu. Bakuuma ekigambo kyabwe. Kye basuubiza, bakituukiriza. Basobola okwesigibwa, ka balabike oba tebalabika. Banyiikivu. Tebeewala buvunaanyizibwa oba okufiiriza ebiseera, wabula bakola emirimu gyabwe n’obwesigwa. Ba kisa, baagala ab’omu maka gaabwe, ba bakkakkamu eri abanafu, era ba kisa eri abo abali mu bwetaavu. Bafaayo nnyo ku balala, nga banoonya okuzzibwawo kw’abo abagudde, era nga basabira abo ababuze. Omuntu ng’oyo abeera n’obulamu obutukuvu, si kungulu kwokka, naye ne munda. Mu birowoozo, mu ndowooza, ne mu kwegomba, banoonya okusanyusa Katonda. Buno bwe bulamu obuva mu mutima omulongoofu. Kino si kya kwegombebwa? Neebaza Katonda ku lw’abo mu mmwe, olw’ekisa kye, abamaze okubeera mu mazima gano—naye njagala mwenna muyingire mu buwo.

2. Omutima Omulongoofu Guleeta Emirembe Omutima omulongoofu era guleeta emirembe. Mu butuufu, emirembe egy’amazima tegiyinza kubaawo awatali gwo. Kaakano, teweesuubira bulamu bwa ssanyu eritakoma wano ku nsi—ekyo tekisoboka. Obunafu bwaffe obw’obuntu, obuzibu bw’obulamu, n’okulwanirira okw’okubeera mu nsi emenyese bikakasa ekyo. Naye emirembe—emirembe gya Katonda amakulu era aganywevu—gwe busika bwo. Era n’omutima omulongoofu, giyinza okuba gyo.

Yee, waliwo entalo ezinaabaawo: Ojja kwolekagana n’okuziyizibwa okuva eri omulabe Ojja kwolekagana n’okugaanibwa okuva eri ensi Ojja kwolekagana n’okusoomoozebwa kubanga oyimirira ku kituufu Naye mu mutima ogulongooseddwa: Okulwana ne Katonda kukomye Okutabangana munda mu muntu kutereedde Okutya okufa n’omusango kuweddewo Omwoyo ng’ogwo guyingidde mu kuwummula kwa Katonda.

Omanyi emirembe gino, bannange? Okulwana okw’omunda kukomye? Toluusa. Leka Omwoyo Omutukuvu, eyeeteefuteefu okukulongoosa okutuukirira, aggyewo buli kintu ekyolekera omwoyo gwo. Si kulwana kwo, si buzibu bwo, wadde obukoomo bwo, ebikunyaga emirembe. Ekibi kye kiri omulabe.

Era amalala, obugayaavu, okwegomba ebitagenderako, obutakkiriza, na buli kibi ekirala bwe biriggyibwawo, olwo emirembe go galikulukuta ng’omugga, n’obutuukirivu bwo bulyekuluumulula ng’amayengo g’ennyanja.

3. Omutima Omulongoofu Gwaniriza Okubeerawo kwa Katonda Obulongoofu bw’omutima kye kisookerwako Katonda okutuula mu ggwe mu bujjuvu.

Wuliriza n’obwegendereza—kino kya kyama ekiyitiridde, naye kya mazima mu kitiibwa: Katonda tayagala kubeera naawe kwokka, wabula n’okutuula munda mu ggwe.

Ne bw’oba ng’olabika ng’atafiibwako oba atalina makulu mu maaso g’ensi, Katonda yennyini—oyo eggulu ly’atayinza kugyamu—ayagala okufuula omutima gwo amaka ge.

Si nga omugenyi, wabula nga oyo asigala.

Omuwandiisi ow’edda yali agamba nti, “Katonda alina amaka abiri: agamu mu ggulu, n’agalala mu mitima gy’abantu be.” Katonda yennyini agamba nti, “Ntuula mu kifo ekigulumivu ekitukuvu awamu n’oyo alina omwoyo oguboneredde ogwetoowaza…” Ate era nti, “Laba nnyimiridde ku luggi era nkonkona… Buli awulira eddoboozi lyange n’aggulawo, nnaayingira omumwe.”

Omuwulira ng’akuyita?

Toomuggulirawo mutima gwo?

Toojja kuleka buli kintu ekimuggalira ebweru?

Ggulawo oluggi lwonna. Muyanirize ayingire—kaakano.

Nnina bingi eby’okwogera ku mulamwa guno ogw’omuwendo, naye biteekwa okulinda ekiseera ekirala.

Toluusa mu kunoonya obulokozi obujjuvu.

fields.title: Obulongoofu N’Okwagala
fields.body_html:
Abaruumi 6:22 wagamba nti, “Naye kaakano obanga mwasumululwa mu kibi, ne mufuuka baddu ba Katonda, ebivaamu bibatuusa ku kutukuzibwa, n’enkomerero bwe bulamu obutaggwaawo.”

Bannange abaagalwa, kasookedde mpandiika ebbaluwa yange eyayita, mbadde nkyalira abantu b’Eggye ery’Obulokozi mu Switzerland, ne mu Itaaliya, ne mu Bufalansa.

Buli gye ŋŋenda, ndaba emikisa emikulu eri Eggye ery’Obulokozi. Buli wantu, nsanga bannange abaagalwa abaagala okukozesa obulungi emikisa gino. Ne buli wantu, kirabika gye ndi nti ekyetaagisa ye ddiini eyaka omuliro esinga esobozese abantu okukola omulimu omukulu oguli mu maaso gaabwe.

Naye si bwe kiri kyekimu ne mu Bungereza, ne mu Amerika, ne mu Awusuteruliya, ne mu buli kifo ekirala ebbaluwa zino gye zinaasomerwa? Si bwe kiri kyekimu ne mu Kikundi kyammwe—era ne mu bulamu bwammwe bwennyini? Nga bwe nnannyonnyola edda, ‘ddiini eyaka omuliro’ ntegeeza emitima egyaka olw’okwagala Katonda, n’okwagala bannaffe, n’okwagala abo ababula, n’okwagala omulimu omusukkulumu, n’okwagala buli kirungi, ku nsi ne mu ggulu. Ntegeeza emitima egijjudde okwagala okutukuvu—okwagala okutuwaliriza okukola n’okwewaayo olw’obulungi bw’abalala. Okwagala okutufuula abaddu b’abo be twagala, era okutuwa amaanyi okuwangula okwegomba kwaffe okw’obwerimi. Okwagala kuno kulaga okwagala kwa Mukama waffe: “Si nti ffe twali twagala Katonda, naye ye yennyini ye yatwagala.”

Tunuulira okwagala kwa maama—si kumuleetera okuwaayo ebiseera bye, n’okwewummuza kwe, n’okutuusa n’obulamu bwe olw’omwana we? Tunuulira okwagala kw’omuntu ayagala ensi ye—si kumuleetera okuleka amaka n’ab’omu maka ge, n’okutuusa n’okwolekera okufa olw’ensi ye? Mu ngeri y’emu, okwagala kuno okwaka mu muntu w’Eggye ery’Obulokozi kunaamuleetera okuteeka ebiseera bye, n’amaanyi ge, n’ebintu bye—buli kimu—ku bigere bya Mukama we, n’akikozesa kyonna okuwa omukisa n’okulokola abalala. Guno gwe mwoyo gw’okwagala ogukola omuliro guno omutukuvu munda. Nga Setaani bw’akoleeza n’aliisa omuliro gw’amalala, n’obwerimi, n’okwegomba okubi, n’ebibi ebirala—ng’atwala abantu eri okuzikirira—bw’atyo n’okwagala okungi okuva mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu kuleetera omukkiriza okukuuma, n’okusaba, n’okukola, n’okwogera, n’okutuusa n’okubonaabona, awatali kufaayo ku muwendo, singa asobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekiteekeddwa mu maaso ge.

Naye Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera n’amaanyi gano amajjuvu mu mitima egyo egyayonjebwa okuva mu kibi gyokka. Kale, bw’oba oyagala ddala okumala obulamu bwo ng’owa abalala omukisa, ng’olokola emyoyo, era ng’oweereza Mukama wo, kikwetaagisa okuba n’omutima omulongoofu.

Omutima omulongoofu gunaakufuula omukisa eri abalala—si lwa bye okola byokka, naye n’olw’ekyo ky’oli. Abantu bayinza okusikirizibwa eri Kristo olw’ebigambo byo, n’ennyimba zo, n’okusaba kwo, n’okukoowoola kwo. Naye okusingawo, bw’oba olina obulongoofu buno obw’omunda, era banaasikirizibwa ekyo kye balaba mu ggwe. Obulamu bwo bwennyini bunaabalaga eri Katonda, n’obutukuvu, n’eggulu.

Nga bwe tulabye, omutima omulongoofu guvaamu obulamu obulungi. Era obulungi busikiriza. Abantu basikirizibwa gye buli era babussaamu ekitiibwa olw’ekyo kye buli. N’abo abagwidde mu kibi tebayinza butasiima kye kitukuvu. Era obanga kino kya mazima eri abo abali ewala ne Katonda, kya mazima nnyo nnyini eri abo abaagala dda obutukuvu? Eri abantu ng’abo, obulamu bwo, bwe bunaabumbibwa okwagala okulongoofu, bunaabeera nsibuko etaggwaawo ey’okugumya, n’amaanyi, n’okubudaabudibwa.

Kino kye tuyita obuyinza obukolera ku balala. Bukola bulijjo. Buli ng’akaloosa k’ekimuli ekya roza. Teeka ekimuli mu kisenge, kinaajjuza mpola ekifo n’akaloosa kaakyo. Toyetaaga kukisiimuula wadde okukikolako kintu—kyereere kisaasaanya akaloosa kaakyo. Bwe kiri bwe kityo eri omuntu alina omutima omulongoofu era abeera mu mazima ago. Obuyinza obutukuvu bukulukuta okuva mu bo bulijjo—si lwa bye boogera ne bye bakola byokka, naye n’olw’ekyo kye bali.

Owulira obwesimbu n’obuziba bw’omwoyo gwabwe. Bwe boogera, oba nga basaba, oba nga batuukirira abalala, ekintu eky’obulamu obwo obw’omunda kirabika. Okiwulira bw’obasisinkana, bw’otuula nabo, wadde bw’obatunuulira obutunuulizi. Okiraba mu biseera eby’okubonaabona, ku nkomerero y’obulamu, n’oluvannyuma lw’ebbanga ddene nga bagenze. Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka, n’okwogera erinnya lyabwe kwokka kuyinza okujjukusa omutima gwo, n’okunyweza okukkiriza kwo, n’okwongera okwagala kwo eri ekirungi n’eky’amazima.

Kiki ekivaako kino, bannange? Kubanga mwamanya nga batukuvu. Mwalaba obulamu bwabwe obutali bwa bwerimi. Mwakkiriza nga baalina omutima omulongoofu. Waliwo ensonga endala ey’okunoonya omutima omulongoofu—guleeta essuubi eddamu era erikakafu. Essuubi lino kirabo kya muwendo nnyo. Okumanya nti, ka kubeere kubonaabona ki okujja, waliwo ebiseera eby’omu maaso ebijjudde emirembe, n’essanyu, n’obuwanguzi—ekyo kintu kya muwendo nnyo. Omuntu ayagala Katonda ddala era atambulira mu buwulize alina obwesige obuteefu nti Katonda anaamulabirira mu buli kigezo.

Naye omuntu amanyi nti wakyaliwo amalala, oba obukyayi, oba omuze gw’ensi, ebikwekeddwa munda, era anyoomya obuvunaanyizibwa bwe, tayinza kuba na bwesige bwe bumu. Bayinza okusuubira ebiseera eby’omu maaso ebirungi, naye binaabeera ebitakakafu era ebinafu.

Naye omuntu bw’aba n’obujulizi bw’Omwoyo n’obulamu obutalyuuka okukakasa obulongoofu obwo obw’omunda, asobola okutunula mu maaso n’obwesige, ng’akakasiza ddala obuwanguzi, n’okununulibwa, n’ekisembayo obulamu obutaggwaawo. Ebintu bino bikusikiriza, bannange? Ka mbibajjukize. Bisikiriza nnyo ddala.

Waliwo obulamu obutukuvu obukulukuta okuva mu mutima omulongoofu—nga amazzi amalongoofu bwe gakulukuta okuva mu nsulo ennongoofu.

Waliwo emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera. Ekibi kyonna ekisigadde kireeta obutabeera bulungi, naye obulongoofu n’emirembe bulijjo bigenda wamu. Waliwo okubeerawo kwa Katonda munda—omuliro omulamu ogw’okwagala okutukuvu ogulongoosa ebigendererwa era ogukyusa omutima. Waliwo obulamu obw’omugaso n’obuyinza obweyongera okwogera ebbanga ddene nga ovuddewo. Era waliwo essuubi eryaka ery’obulamu obutaggwaawo—ekisuubizo eky’ekitiibwa n’empeera ebijja.

Bino byonna, bannange, byesigamye ku kintu kimu: omutima omulongoofu. Gino ge mamwe ku migisa emingi etabalika egikulukuta okuva mu nsulo eno ey’obulongoofu n’amaanyi. Olina eky’obugagga kino? Bw’oba nakyo, weebaze Katonda. Bw’oba tolina, kinoonye kaakano.

fields.title: Obulongoofu Busoboka
fields.body_html:
Abaebbulaniya 13:12 wagamba nti, “Noolwekyo ne Yesu kyeyava abonaabonera era n’afiira ebweru w’ekibuga alyoke atutukuze n’omusaayi gwe ye.”

Bannange abaagalwa, nsobola okuteebereza mangu nti abamu ku Baserikale bange, oluvannyuma lw’okusoma bye mpandiise ku mutima omulongoofu, bayinza okuba nga beebuuza nti, “Ddala kisoboka nze okufuna kino?” Mmanyi nti abantu bangi abatali mu kibiina kyaffe boogera lwatu nti obulamu obwo tebusoboka. Bagamba nti tewali muntu ayinza kubeera mu nsi muno nga tayonoona. Bawakana nti ka tukyawe ekibi, ka tukinakuwalire, ka tukisabire, oba ka twesige Kristo olw’obuwanguzi, kigwanidde tusigale nga tuwanguddwa—nga twonoona ne twenenya emirundi n’emirundi okutuusa ku nkomerero y’obulamu.

Nga nziramu kino, nnywerera awamu n’Omutume Yokaana ne njatula nti Katonda tasiima kwokka era nga asobola okusonyiwa ekibi, ekyo omukkiriza yenna mu Byawandiikibwa ky’atayinza kwegaana, naye nti mu ngeri y’emu asiima era asobola okutunaazaako obutali butuukirivu bwonna. Naye nga tetunnaba kweyongerayo, ka tutegeere bulungi ekigambibwa. Sirangirira kintu kitono okusinga kino: nti Katonda asobola okukukuuma obutayonoona.

Abamu bayinza okubuuza nti, “Ekibi kiki?” Omutume Yokaana akiddamu mu bwangu nti, “Buli ekitali kya butuukirivu kibi.” Mu ngeri endala, buli kye tukola—oba kye tukkiriza—mu birowoozo, mu kwegomba, oba mu bikolwa, kye tumanyi nga kibi, kibi. Kaakano njatula, ku buyinza bw’Ebyawandiikibwa, nti Yesu Kristo Omulokozi wo asiima era asobola okukukuuma obutakola ekibi. Yatuumibwa Yesu kubanga “y’alirokola abantu bonna mu bibi byabwe.”

Nga bwe njogedde emabega, oyinza okusigala ng’ogezesebwa. Oyinza okuwulira okuggwaamu amaanyi, obulumi bw’omubiri, okutabukatabuka mu birowoozo, oba ennaku ennyingi. Ensi eyinza okukulwanyisa. Ebiseera eby’ekizikiza biyinza okujja. Oyinza n’okuwulira, nga Kristo bwe yawulira ku musaalaba, ng’oleseewo. Kyokka, wakati mu bino byonna, oyinza okukuumibwa obutayonoona. Mu linnya lya Mukama, njatula nti kisoboka gy’oli okuba n’omutima omulongoofu era okugukuuma. Bangi ku mmwe bakikkiririza dda. Naye eri abo abakyakubagana n’okubuusabuusa, ka nkyongere okukitangaaza.

Okusooka, toyinza kubuusabuusa buyinza bwa Katonda okukola kino. Yakutonda, akuwaniriza, yakununula, yakusonyiwa, era yakusuubiza obulamu obutaggwaawo. Mazima ddala, asobola okukukuuma obutayonoona mu kiseera ekitono ky’osigazza ku nsi. Nkakasa nti asobola.

Yee, kiyinza okulabika ng’ekizibu. Embeera zo ziyinza okuba enzibu. Wayinza okubaawo okunyigirizibwa mu maka go oba mu mirimu gyo okulwanyisa obulamu obutukuvu. fields.title: Obulongoofu, Ekirabo kya Katonda
fields.body_html:
2 Abakkolinso 4:7 wagamba nti, “Naye kaakano tulina ekyobugagga kino mu bibya eby’ebbumba, okulaga nti obuyinza bwonna bwa Katonda, so si bwaffe.”

Baganda bange abaagalwa, kaakano ntuuse ku kimu ku bitundu ebisinga obukulu ku nsonga eno: Omutima Omulongoofu guyinza gutya okufunibwa? Nga mpulira ekibuuzo nga kivaayo munda yammwe: “Kirungi, kya muwendo, era kyegombebwa—naye nnaakifuna ntya?”

Ka tulabe mu bufunze ku ebyo bye tumaze okuyita mu ffenna.

Okusooka, twalowooza ku kiki ddala obutukuvu bye buli—si nneewulira ey’essanyu etaggwaawo, wadde obulamu obuwa ekibangirizi ekibi. Oluvannyuma ne tulaba omugaso gwabwo: emirembe, obugasi, n’ekisa kya Katonda ekigenda mu maaso. Twategeeza era nti obulamu buno busoboka eri buli muntu—omuto oba omukulu, omugagga oba omwavu—kubanga Katonda asobola okutukuza n’okuwanirira obulamu obutukuvu.

Kaakano tutuuka ku musingi gw’ensonga: Gufunibwa gutya? Amaanyi Abiri Agakola. Bw’obuuza nti, “Nsaanidde kukola ki okuba omulongoofu?” eky’okuddamu kye kino: waliwo ekyetaaga okukolebwa, era ekitundu ku kyo kiri ku ggwe.

Waliwo amaanyi abiri agakwatibwako: Ag’Obwakatonda — Katonda Ag’Obuntu — Ggwe Katonda n’omuntu bakolera awamu, nga bwe kiri mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku. Ggwe okola, ne Katonda n’awa. Mu kukyuka, weenenya n’okkiriza—Katonda n’akulokola. Ne wano bwe kityo. Okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero, Katonda ye alokola. Nyweza amazima ago mu birowoozo byo: Omutima Omulongoofu guva eri Katonda yekka. Ye yekka asobola okuggyawo amalala, obusungu, okwerowoozaako wekka, na buli kibi eky’omunda—n’abizzaawo okwagala n’emirembe. Guno gwe mulimu gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, omuliro ogutukuza. Nga kya kubudaabuda—okumanya nti Oyo asobola era y’oyo ayagala.

Omulimu Gwo: Okukkiriza Katonda ng’akola omulimu, obuvunaanyizibwa bwo bulambulukufu: oteekwa okukkiriza. Ebyawandiikibwa biyigiriza nti omutima gutukuzibwa olw’okukkiriza. Emmeeme bw’ejja eri Katonda, n’eweerayo ddala eri okwagala kwe, n’emwesiga okugutukuza—mu kaseera ako kennyini, omulimu guba gukoleddwa. Okukkiriza kwogera nti, “Kaakano gwange.”

Ekitalitukuza Mutima Ka twogere bulungi ku ekyo ekitasobola kuleeta bulongoofu buno: 1. Si kufuba kw’omuntu Tewali muntu asobola kutukuza mutima gwo—si mubuulizi, si mukulembeze, si mukwano. Kristo yekka y’asobola okukola ekyo.

2. Si mikolo gya ddiini gyokka Enkuŋŋaana, okusaba, n’ennyimba biyamba, naye awatali kukkiriza kwa mazima, biba bya bwereere.

3. Si kumanya Oyinza okutegeera obutukuvu mu buziba naye n’otobufunako.

4. Si kwenenya kwokka Bangi bawulira ennaku olw’ekibi ne bagezaako okukyuka, naye ne batatuuka ku kukkiriza obununuzi obujjuvu.

5. Si kwewaayo kwokka Oyinza okwewaayo eri Katonda, naye awatali maanyi ge, tosobola kubutuukiriza.

Omutendera Ogusembayo Bino byonna biyinza okukukulembera mu maaso—naye waliwo omutendera gumu gw’oteekwa okukola: Okukkiriza.

Oyinza okugamba nti: “Nneegomba” “Nneenenya” “Nneewaayo” Naye onoogamba nti: “Nzikiriza nti Katonda antukuza kaakano.”

Ogwo gwe mutendera ogusembayo—akaseera okwegomba lwe kufuuka amazima.

fields.title: Okukkiriza Okulongoosa
fields.body_html:
Abaefeso 3:17-19 wagamba nti, “Kristo alyoke abeerenga mu mitima gyammwe olw’okukkiriza kwammwe. Mbasabira mubeerenga n’emirandira mu kwagala nga mukunywereddemu, mulyoke mubeerenga n’amaanyi awamu n’abatukuvu bonna, okusobola okutegeera obugazi, n’obuwanvu, n’obugulumivu n’okukka wansi ebiri mu kwagala kwa Kristo. Njagala mutegeere okwagala kwa Kristo okusukkiridde okutegeera kwonna, mulyoke musobole okutegeerera ddala Katonda bw’ali.”

Bannange abaagalwa, Mujja kujjukira nti bwe nnamaliriza ebbaluwa yange eyayita, nnali njogera ku kitundu ekikulu ennyo eky’ensonga yaffe—kwe kugamba, ekikolwa eky’okukkiriza ekirongoosa omutima. Nnayogerako ekigambo mu kiseera ekyo, naye nteekwa okukiddamu, kubanga wano abangi we beesittala ne balemwa mu kunoonya omukisa gw’obulongoofu.

Batuuka ddala ku luggi lw’okulokolebwa okujjuvu okuva mu kibi. Batunuulira munda mu yeekaalu ey’obutukuvu. Baagala nnyo okuyingira. Naye ne batya okutwala ekigere kiri ekimu ekyandibayingizza munda.

Tebakozesa kukkiriza kuli okulongoosa. Kyebava badda emabega—nga bakomawo mu bulamu obwo obutamalirira obw’okwonoona n’okwenenya, mwe babadde okumala ebbanga eddene.

fields.title: Abajulirwa
fields.body_html:
Mu Ebikolwa 1:8 wawandiikibwa nti, “Naye muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange mu Yerusaalemi, ne mu Buyudaaya yonna, ne mu Samaliya okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero z’ensi.”

Baganda bange abaagalwa, mukooye omulamwa guno? Nsuubira nti nedda. Nze kennyini, okuva mu nnaku zange ez’obuto okutuusa kaakano, omulamwa gw’obutukuvu tegwabulako bulungi bwagwo. Okwogera ku maanyi ga Kristo agalongoosa omutima, okugujjuza okwagala, n’okugukuuma guleme okugwa, bulijjo kubadde kumu ku kusanyuka okusinga mu bulamu bwange.

Era kikyali bwe kityo ne kaakano.

Mazima ddala, tusaanidde okumanyisa kino—si mu bigambo byaffe byokka, naye ne mu bulamu bwaffe—nti Yesu Kristo teyajja kusonyiwa kibi kyokka, wabula okulongoosa omutima n’okugufuula omulongoofu. Naye oboolyawo abamu ku mmwe mukyabuusabuusa. Muyinza okwebuuza obanga obulamu ng’obwo busoboka ddala. Kale ka tuwulire obujulizi bw’abalala. Tutandika n’abo abaawandiikibwa obulamu bwabwe mu Byawandiikibwa. Enoka yatambulira wamu ne Katonda emyaka ebikumi bisatu era n’amusanyusa. Nuuwa yayitibwa omutuukirivu mu mulembe gwe.

Yobu yalangirirwa nga mugolokofu, omuntu eyeesiga Katonda ne mu kubonaabona. Ibulayimu yagondera Katonda mu bujjuvu, ne bwe kyali eky’omuwendo omungi. Isaaya yalongoosebwa n’amangwago ne yeewaayo mu buweereza bwa Katonda. Zaakaliya ne Erizabeeti baayogerwako nga batuukirivu, nga batambulira mu butaliiko kya kunenyezebwa mu maaso ga Katonda.

Yokaana yayogera ku kwagala okutuukiridde. Pawulo yasobola okukoowoola abalala okuba abajulirwa ku butukuvu bw’obulamu bwe.

Buno si bujulizi butono. Bulaga Katonda ky’asobola okukola. Era bwe tutunula okusukka Ebyawandiikibwa, tusanga obujulizi bwe bumu nga buddiŋŋanwa. Yokaana Fuletika yalangirira nti yali afudde eri ekibi era nti Kristo ye byonna mu byonna gyali. Abalala baayogera ku kaseera amaanyi ga Katonda lwe gaabakkako—si mu kusalira musango, naye mu kwagala—nga gabajjuza obulamu obuggya. Omulala yajulira nti yali atambulidde mu ddembe lino okumala emyaka mingi, ng’akuumibwa amaanyi ga Katonda. Bino si birowoozo bufuufu.

Bino bye bulamu obw’amazima. Kale, baganda bange, musigazza n’okusalawo. Muwulidde nti obulamu ng’obwo busoboka. Mulabye nti Katonda asobola era mwesigwa. Mubulaggiddwa ekkubo.

Munaakola ki?

Mukama wo alindirira okukuyingiza mu bulamu buno obw’obulongoofu n’okwagala.

Tolwawo.

Yingira—olw’okukkiriza.

Ne bw’oba nga ku ntandikwa toyinza kutuukiriza, tolekaawo. Yongera. Noonya nate. Kkiriza nate. Kubanga ekisuubizo kisigala nga kikakafu.

fields.title: Engeri y’Okukuuma Obulongoofu
fields.body_html:
Yakobo 1:12 agamba nti, “Alina omukisa omuntu agumira okukemebwa, kubanga bw’alimala okusiimibwa aliweebwa engule ey’obulamu Katonda gye yasuubiza abo abamwagala.”

Bannange abaagalwa, Bwe mmaze okugezaako okubalaga obulungi bw’okufuna ekyo, era nga mbakubiriza mukkirize okukyaniriza, sisobola butawulira nti okubuulirira kutono ku ngeri esinga obulungi ey’okukuuma omukisa gw’Obutukuvu ng’gumaze okufunibwa kuyinza okuba okw’omugaso. Awatali kubuusabuusa, bangi bafuna eky’obugagga ekitukuvu eky’Omutima Omulongoofu, ne basanyukira obwesige n’essanyu bye guleeta, naye oluvannyuma lw’akaseera akatono ne baddamu okugufiirwa. Bayingira mu Yeekaalu Entukuvu, oluvannyuma, olw’ensonga emu oba endala, ne bagireka. Bafuba n’amaziga n’okusaba okulinnya ku Luguudo Olunene olw’Obutukuvu, oluvannyuma ne bakyama ne bakwata akakubo akalala, gye baddamu okufuuka omuyiggo gw’okubuusabuusa n’okutya n’ebibi eby’edda. Kino kya nnaku nnyingi.

Abo abakola bwe batyo be babonaabona okusinga; naye, zaawe! Obutali bwesigwa bwabwe buleeta n’obulumi obungi ku balala. Naye obulemerere bw’abo abalemwa okukuuma kye baafuna tebusaanidde kubamalamu maanyi mmwe abayingidde mu kkubo lino ettukuvu, era tebusaanidde kubaziyiza kunyiikira mu lyo.

Kye musaanidde okukola, bannange, kwe kumalirira mu mitima gyammwe nti nga mumaze okuzuula Ejjinja ery’Omuwendo Omungi, tewali mulabe n’omu anaabanyaga eky’obugagga ekyo. Olw’ekyo, okubuulirira kwange okusooka kwe kuno: 1. Noonya okutuusa lw’onoofuna obukakafu obunywevu mu mutima gwo nti omulimu gukoleddwa. Tomatira ku kintu kyonna ekitono okusinga obukakafu nti Katonda addala addala azze n’atukuza emmeeme yo okuva mu kibi.

Temweganya kuwummuliramu mu nneewulira ennungi zokka, oba mu ssuubi lyonna ery’okubikkulirwa okw’omu maaso ku nsonga eno. Weeyongere okumeguza, n’okusaba, n’okukkiriza, okutuusa lw’onoomatira nti omulimu guweddemu.

Naye obuuza nate nti, “Nnyinza ntya okumanya oba Katonda azze n’atukuza emmeeme yange okuva mu kibi?” Nziramu nti, “Wamanya otya nti Katonda yali akusonyiye ebibi byo? Watuuka otya okumanya ekyo eky’omuwendo? Kubanga mazima ddala, kyali kya muwendo lwe walokolebwa. Ndowooza nti kasookedde ekirabo ekyo eky’ekisa kifuuka kikyo, oyimbye emirundi olukumi oba n’okusinga, ebigambo bino: ” “Siryerabira olunaku Yesu lwe yanaaza ebibi byange.”

“Watuuka otya okuba n’obukakafu bwo ggwe kennyini nti walokolebwa?” mbuuza, ne onziramu nti Katonda yakyogera mu mutima gwo. Kale, obukakafu obw’Okutukuzibwa kwo bulijja mu ngeri y’emu.

Omwoyo Omutukuvu alireeta okukakasa okusanyusa mu mmeeme yo nti amalala gonna, n’obukyayi, n’obuggya, n’okwerowoozaako wekka biggiddwawo, era nti Katonda akujjuzza emirembe n’okwagala.

Okukakasa kuno okw’omuwendo, awatali kubuusabuusa, kulijjira mu ngeri ez’enjawulo eri abantu ab’enjawulo. Eri abamu kulirabika ng’“Okuwummula okw’Okukkiriza,” eri abalala nga “Okubatizibwa okw’Omuliro,” eri abalala nga “Okujjula okw’Okwagala,” ne eri abalala ng’Okutuuza Kristo ku ntebe okufuga mu mmeeme zaabwe okusukkuluma ku Bwakabaka obw’omunda, obuli butuukirivu, n’emirembe, n’essanyu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu.

Naye eri bonna awamu, omulimu bwe guba nga gwa mazima era nga gutuukiridde, waliba obukakafu nti omusaayi gutukuza era nti omutima mulongoofu. Tomatira ku kintu kyonna ekitono okusinga kino, era leka ku kwagala kwa Katonda okulungi okuwa oba okumma ebisingawo.

2. Bw’omala okumatizibwa nti Katonda atukuzza omutima gwo, kyatula. Osaanidde okukola bw’otyo bw’oba oyagala okukuuma Omukisa. Bangi ku basajja n’abakazi abasingayo obutukuvu ensi be yamanya, olw’okuwulira ensonyi ez’obulimba oba okwekwekera oba ensonga endala, baaziyizibwa okwatula ebintu eby’ekitalo Katonda bye yabakolera, ne banakuwaza bwe batyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu ne bafiirwa Omukisa. Setaani alikukema okukweka ettabaaza yo wansi w’ekibbo mu ngeri y’emu, naye osaanidde okumuziyiza n’okwatula n’obuvumu eri bonna abakwetoolodde Obulokozi Katonda bw’akuwadde.

Kyatule eri ggwe kennyini. Gamba omutima gwo emirundi n’emirundi nti: “Ekitiibwa, Ekitiibwa, Yesu andokola; Ekitiibwa, Ekitiibwa eri Omwana gw’Endiga”; Kaakano Omusaayi Ogutukuza gutuuse gye ndi, Ekitiibwa, Ekitiibwa eri Omwana gw’Endiga!”
